title: Event-Study Designs for Discrete Outcomes with Latent Transition Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2603.07914v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop an identification strategy for average treatment effects on the treated (ATT) in panel data with discrete outcomes. For such outcomes, the parallel trends assumption underlying difference-in-differences (DiD) fails in three distinct ways: mean reversion generates divergent trends when groups differ at baseline, counterfactual probabilities can leave the unit interval, and no single trend is well defined for multi-category outcomes. We replace parallel trends with \textit{transition independence}: absent treatment, transition dynamics conditional on pre-treatment outcomes would be identical between treated and control groups. To accommodate selection on persistent unobserved heterogeneity in transition dynamics, we require transition independence to hold only within latent types. translated_title: 具有潜在转移异质性的离散结果事件研究设计
translated_abstract: 我们针对具有离散结果的面板数据，开发了一种处理组平均处理效应（ATT）的识别方法。对于此类结果，双重差分法（DiD）所依赖的平行趋势假设在三个方面失效：当处理组与对照组在基线期存在差异时，均值回归会导致趋势发散；反事实概率可能超出单位区间；对于多类别结果，无法定义单一的趋势。我们用“转移独立性”假设取代平行趋势假设：在没有处理的情况下，以处理前结果为条件的转移动态在处理组和对照组之间是相同的。为了适应转移动态中基于持续性不可观测异质性的选择问题，我们仅要求转移独立性在潜在类型内部成立。通过将结果建模为马尔可夫链的有限混合模型，我们能够从短面板数据中识别出潜在类型层面和总体层面的ATT。该框架还产生了一个...
tldr: 该论文提出用“转移独立性”假设取代平行趋势假设，并将结果建模为马尔可夫链的有限混合模型，从而在离散结果的面板数据中克服均值回归、概率越界和多类别趋势不唯一等问题，识别出具有潜在转移异质性下的处理组平均处理效应。
en_tdlr: This paper replaces the parallel trends assumption with "transition independence" within latent types and models outcomes as a finite mixture of Markov chains, enabling identification of average treatment effects on the treated in panel data with discrete outcomes.
